'''Nick Levoter Weatherspoon''' (July 20, 1950 – October 17, 2008)<ref name="beaven">{{cite news |first=Chris |last=Beaven |title=Former McKinley, NBA basketball player Nick Weatherspoon dies |date=October 18, 2008 |url=http://www.cantonrep.com/index.php?ID=436825&r=0&Category=9&subCategoryID=0 |accessdate=2008-10-18 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20081022004715/http://www.cantonrep.com/index.php?ID=436825&r=0&Category=9&subCategoryID=0 |archivedate=October 22, 2008}}</ref> was an American professional [[basketball]] player.

==Career==
Weatherspoon, nicknamed "Spoon", scored 1,431 points at [[Canton McKinley High School]], holding the Bulldog scoring record for 37 years until Raymar Morgan broke it during the 2005–06 season. He was an [[All-American]] at the [[University of Illinois]] before being selected by the [[Capital Bullets]] with the 13th pick of the [[1973 NBA draft]].<ref>[http://collegehoopedia.com/players/nick-weatherspoon CollegeHoopedia.com]</ref> Named to the 1974 [[NBA All-Rookie Team]], Weatherspoon spent a total of seven seasons in the NBA with the Bullets, the [[Seattle SuperSonics]], the [[Chicago Bulls]], and the [[Los Angeles Clippers#1978–1984: San Diego Clippers|San Diego Clippers]].<ref name="beaven" />

Weatherspoon was elected to the "[[Illinois Fighting Illini men's basketball#All-Century Team|Illini Men's Basketball All-Century Team]]" in 2004. He was a member of [[Alpha Phi Alpha]] fraternity, and was initiated in the Fraternity through Tau chapter in 1971.

==Honors==

===Basketball===
* 1972 – Team MVP<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://s3.amazonaws.com/sidearm.sites/fightingillini.com/documents/2018/10/5/2018_19_ILLINI_MBB_Record_Book.pdf |title=FightingIllini.com |access-date=March 11, 2019 |archive-date=August 24, 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220824121512/https://s3.amazonaws.com/sidearm.sites/fightingillini.com/documents/2018/10/5/2018_19_ILLINI_MBB_Record_Book.pdf |url-status=dead }}</ref>
* 1972 – Honorable Mention All-[[Big Ten Conference|Big Ten]]
* 1973 – Team Captain
* 1973 – Team MVP
* 1973 – 1st Team All-Big Ten
* 1973 – Honorable Mention [[1973 NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|All American]]
* 2004 – Elected to the "[[Illinois Fighting Illini men's basketball#All-Century Team|Illini Men's Basketball All-Century Team]]".
* 2008 – [[Illinois_Fighting_Illini_men%27s_basketball#Honored_jerseys|Honored jersey]] which hangs in the [[State Farm Center]] to show regard for being the most decorated basketball players in the University of Illinois' history.
